trial_title: Open-Label Study, Evaluating Patient Satisfaction and Symptom Improvement When Treating Male Hypogonadism With Natesto™
brief_summary: Multicenter study consisting of two study periods as follows: a 90-day Treatment Period, with potential extension by 30 days for those patients requiring a dose increase, as determined by the treating physician. Participants receiving 122.5mg of NATESTO (5.5 mg of testosterone) per nostril twice daily may have an increased daily dose adjustment on Day 90, based on their hypogonadism symptoms.

eligibility_table.criterion: Hypogonadal male between 18 and 65 years of age, inclusive;
Hypogonadal male between 18 and 65 years of age, inclusive;
Able to understand and provide signed informed consent;
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 19 years old and can understand and provide signed informed consent.

eligibility_table.criterion: Have documented total serum testosterone levels ≤300 ng/dL;
eligibility_table.justification: No lab values in patient profile
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a documented total serum testosterone level of ≤300 ng/dL?

eligibility_table.criterion: Are currently being treated with any form of a topical testosterone replacement therapy for at least three months, or are treatment-naive.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is treatment-naive, as there are no current medications listed.

eligibility_table.criterion: In the opinion of the Investigator, significant intercurrent disease of any type, in particular liver, kidney, heart disease, stroke, or psychiatric illness;
eligibility_table.justification: There is no indication of significant intercurrent disease based on the provided information.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of pituitary or hypothalamic tumors or history of any malignancy (including breast and prostate cancers) excluding basal cell or squamous cell carcinoma of the skin curatively treated by surgery;
eligibility_table.justification: No history of pituitary or hypothalamic tumors or malignancy is reported.

eligibility_table.criterion: Prostatomegaly or history of abnormal PSA levels (>10.0 ng/mL). If PSA is >10 ng/mL, a recent negative biopsy must be documented (within the last 12 months);
eligibility_table.justification: No evidence of prostatomegaly or abnormal PSA levels is provided.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of nasal disorders, nasal or sinus surgery, nasal fracture within the previous 6 months or nasal fracture that caused a deviated anterior nasal septum surgery, mucosal inflammatory disorders, specifically Sjogren's syndrome;
eligibility_table.justification: No history of nasal disorders or surgeries is mentioned.

eligibility_table.criterion: Use of any form of intranasal medication delivery other than periodic short-term (less than 3 days) use of sympathomimetic decongestants;
eligibility_table.justification: There is no indication of the use of intranasal medications.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of severe adverse drug reactions to testosterone therapies;
eligibility_table.justification: No history of severe adverse drug reactions to testosterone therapies is reported.

eligibility_table.criterion: History or current evidence of abuse of alcohol or any drug substance;
eligibility_table.justification: No history or evidence of substance abuse is provided.

eligibility_table.criterion: Current treatment with other androgens (e.g., dehydroepiandrosterone [DHEA]), anabolic steroids, or other sex hormones;
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is not currently being treated with other androgens or sex hormones.

eligibility_table.criterion: Treatment with estrogens, gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) agonists, or growth hormone within the previous 12 months;
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not received any treatment with estrogens, GnRH agonists, or growth hormone in the past 12 months.

eligibility_table.criterion: Treatment with drugs that interfere with the metabolism of testosterone, such as anastrozole, clomiphene, dutasteride, finasteride, flutamide, ketoconazole, spironolactone, or testolactone;
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is not currently on any medications that interfere with testosterone metabolism.
There is no information provided regarding the patient's compliance history, making it unclear.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient missed ≥3 doses of any prescribed testosterone therapy in the past 6 months?

eligibility_table.criterion: Participation in any other research study during the conduct of this study or 30 days prior to the initiation of this study.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not participated in any other research study during the specified timeframe.
